parameters.query:
SELECT
    sc.flight_id,
    sc.class AS seat_class,
    sc.total_seats,
    sc.available_seats,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM bookings b
        WHERE b.flight_id = sc.flight_id
          AND b.seat_class = sc.class
          AND b.status IN ('held', 'confirmed')
    ) AS booking_count,

    (
        sc.total_seats - sc.available_seats
    ) AS calculated_booked,

    (
        (sc.total_seats - sc.available_seats) !=
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM bookings b
            WHERE b.flight_id = sc.flight_id
              AND b.seat_class = sc.class
              AND b.status IN ('held', 'confirmed')
        )
    ) AS has_inconsistency

FROM seat_classes sc
ORDER BY sc.flight_id, sc.class;
